blocking_findings.title: BASISLV fold-4 selection conflicts with the plan's deterministic law; required census evidence is missing
blocking_findings.detail: Plan section 6: fold-4 per family = 'Y2020P if that family's P0 stamp census passes, else Y2024P (deterministic fallback, chosen now) ... The Y2020P-or-Y2024P choice is made per family BEFORE any of that family's scored cells run and is recorded with the census evidence.' The conditionality is family-generic (2 arms x 4 folds x 3 families = 24); it is NOT ILLIQ-specific. replication_data.FOLDS pins Y2024P for BASISLV, but (i) no BASISLV Y2020P census evidence exists on file anywhere in the control tree, and (ii) A7's independent measurement of the BASISLV Y2020P window (2020-11-16..2021-01-01; check H1) shows the census would PASS (0 eligibility-refused stamps; 3 OK books at n_eligible=12=MIN_ELIGIBLE, 2 fold-terminal flat transitions). Left unadjudicated, the scored sweep would run Y2024P where the plan's own deterministic rule (absent a recorded owner override) selects Y2020P -- a trial-identity defect in the scored denominator's content, in tension with the section 3 boundary law 'No window substitution, no post-hoc year selection'. The dispatch packet's scope list alone does not satisfy section 6's recording requirement.
blocking_findings.remediation: Before the owner GO gate, record the BASISLV fold-4 decision WITH the census evidence, in the control tree, and re-run A7 (mechanical round 2 -- every other check passed and is re-verifiable from this artifact): EITHER (a) attach the Y2020P census measurement (values in check H1) and amend the plan/dispatch to fold-4 = Y2020P for BASISLV (deterministic rule; budget unchanged at 20 <= 24; note Y2020P partials are reported separately from annual aggregates per section 8), OR (b) attach the same census measurement + an explicit owner override note selecting Y2024P for BASISLV, superseding section 6's default for this family by owner decision (authority order 1). No code change is required in either branch; replication_data.FOLDS already matches (b) and the Y2020P window string exists in plan section 3 for (a).
